sun.phraseReversed: good things dimmed rather than gone

judgment.name: Judgment
judgment.byline: the call to look at all of it
judgment.upright: Look back at all of it honestly. Not to punish yourself, to understand. Forgive what you can, and answer the call you have been putting off.
judgment.reversed: Judging yourself harshly and changing nothing. Or hearing the call and ignoring it.
judgment.phraseUpright: an honest look back, and a call to answer

world.name: The World
world.keywords: Completion, wholeness, arrival, a cycle closed
world.upright: Something is genuinely complete. Let it be finished and take in the whole of it. Then, when you are ready, begin the next thing.
world.reversed: Almost done. Either the last step is left undone, or you cannot let it end because you do not know what follows.

wands-ace.name: Ace of Wands
wands-ace.keywords: Inspiration, raw energy, a beginning with heat in it
wands-ace.upright: A new spark of energy, or an idea worth following. It is real but it has no shape yet. Act on it soon, while it is still alive.
wands-ace.reversed: The spark does not catch. A false start, or energy with nowhere to go yet.
wands-ace.phraseUpright: a spark with real energy and no shape yet
wands-ace.phraseReversed: a spark that does not catch

wands-two.name: Two of Wands
wands-two.keywords: Planning, foresight, the first real decision
wands-two.upright: You have proved that it works. Now decide how far you want to take it. The choice you make now sets the size of what follows.
wands-two.reversed: Planning without moving. Or choosing the smaller version out of fear.
wands-two.phraseUpright: the moment you decide how far to take it

wands-three.name: Three of Wands
wands-three.upright: The work is out of your hands and moving. Your part is done for the moment. Wait well, and expect more back than you put in.
wands-three.reversed: Slower than you hoped, or smaller. Impatience with something that takes the time it takes.
wands-three.phraseUpright: work already out of your hands and moving
wands-three.phraseReversed: something slower or smaller than you hoped

wands-four.name: Four of Wands
wands-four.upright: Something has come together and it is worth stopping for. Mark it, with people if you can. Milestones you do not mark stop feeling like milestones.
wands-four.reversed: Passing over something that deserved marking. Or a home or a base that is not steady yet.
wands-four.phraseUpright: something come together, worth stopping for

wands-five.name: Five of Wands
wands-five.upright: Everyone wants the same thing and nobody is wrong. It is messy rather than serious. There is real energy here once it is pointed somewhere.
wands-five.reversed: The disagreement ends, or gets swallowed to keep the peace. Neither of those is the same as resolved.
wands-five.phraseUpright: everyone wanting the same thing at once
wands-five.phraseReversed: a disagreement swallowed rather than settled

wands-six.name: Six of Wands
wands-six.upright: Your effort is recognized. Accept it plainly, without shrugging it off. Enjoy it, and remember that one good moment is not the whole story.
wands-six.reversed: Work that goes unseen. Or needing the praise more than you needed the work.
wands-six.phraseUpright: effort that is finally being seen
wands-six.phraseReversed: work nobody notices, or praise needed too much

wands-seven.name: Seven of Wands
wands-seven.upright: You are defending something you believe in, and your position is sound. Keep going. The danger is tiring of having to explain yourself.
wands-seven.reversed: Worn down, or defensive when nobody is attacking. Sometimes giving up just before it turns.
wands-seven.phraseUpright: a position worth defending, and defensible
wands-seven.phraseReversed: being worn down, or braced against nothing

wands-eight.name: Eight of Wands
wands-eight.upright: Things speed up. News arrives, and what was stuck starts moving. Keep up with it, and do not expect this pace to last.
wands-eight.reversed: Delays, or too much happening at once for anything to land properly.
wands-eight.phraseReversed: delays, or too much landing at the same time

wands-nine.name: Nine of Wands
wands-nine.upright: You are tired and still standing. You have more left than you think, and you are closer to the end of this than it feels.
wands-nine.reversed: Guarded even when there is no threat. Or refusing help right at the end.
wands-nine.phraseReversed: a guard kept up long after the threat has gone

wands-ten.name: Ten of Wands
wands-ten.upright: You are carrying too much, and some of it is not yours. Put it down and sort out what you actually agreed to carry.
wands-ten.reversed: Something finally set down. Or a weight about to become too much.
wands-ten.phraseUpright: carrying more than is actually yours
wands-ten.phraseReversed: a weight set down, or about to break you

wands-page.name: Page of Wands
wands-page.keywords: Curiosity, a spark of news, beginner's fire
wands-page.upright: Someone is excited about something new and does not know enough yet to be cautious. That is exactly why they will try it.
wands-page.reversed: Excitement that fades quickly. Starting many things and finishing none of them.
wands-page.phraseUpright: excitement not yet slowed by knowing better
wands-page.phraseReversed: enthusiasm that fades by the end of the week

wands-knight.name: Knight of Wands
wands-knight.upright: Bold, charming, and ready to leave. Great at starting things and rarely there at the end. Go, but know that about yourself.
wands-knight.reversed: Rushing into something at a cost. Or restless energy with nowhere to put it.
wands-knight.phraseUpright: bold movement with the bag already packed

wands-queen.name: Queen of Wands
wands-queen.upright: Warm and sure of herself without needing to prove it. Generous with encouragement. People feel steadier around her.
wands-queen.reversed: Confidence that has turned brittle. Needing attention, or quietly running out of self-belief.
wands-queen.phraseUpright: warmth that does not need to prove itself

wands-king.name: King of Wands
wands-king.upright: He can see where this could go, and he can bring people with him. Vision, nerve, and the experience to know what is worth starting.
wands-king.reversed: Big talk and no direction. Impatient with anyone slower than he is.
wands-king.phraseUpright: vision plus the nerve to act on it
wands-king.phraseReversed: big talk with no direction under it

cups-ace.name: Ace of Cups
cups-ace.keywords: New feeling, love offered, an open heart
cups-ace.upright: Something is being offered to you, and it is about feeling rather than practicality. Love, friendship, or a feeling coming back. Let it in.
cups-ace.reversed: Feeling held back. Or something offered at a time when you cannot receive it.
cups-ace.phraseUpright: an offer of feeling, waiting to be let in
cups-ace.phraseReversed: feeling held back, or offered at the wrong moment

cups-two.name: Two of Cups
cups-two.upright: Two people meet each other properly. What one offers turns out to be what the other needed. This is connection, not just attraction.
cups-two.reversed: One person carrying it alone. A break, or a repair that is still within reach.
cups-two.phraseUpright: two people actually meeting each other
cups-two.phraseReversed: one person carrying the whole thing

cups-three.name: Three of Cups
cups-three.upright: Good company and shared happiness. Friends, a celebration, people who are glad you are there. Say yes to it.
cups-three.reversed: Strain in a group. Someone left out, or celebrating to avoid something.
cups-three.phraseReversed: a group with somebody quietly left out

cups-four.name: Four of Cups
cups-four.upright: You have good things in front of you and none of them interest you right now. The dullness is real. So is what you have not noticed yet.
cups-four.reversed: Interest coming back. Or a withdrawal that has lasted long enough to become the problem.
cups-four.phraseUpright: good things in front of you and no interest in them
cups-four.phraseReversed: interest returning, or a sulk gone on too long

cups-five.name: Five of Cups
cups-five.upright: Something was lost and it mattered. Grieve it properly. When you are ready, notice that not everything went with it.
cups-five.reversed: The grief easing. Or a loss carried so long that it has become who you are.
cups-five.phraseUpright: a loss that mattered, still being felt
cups-five.phraseReversed: grief easing, or grief turned into an identity

cups-six.name: Six of Cups
cups-six.upright: A return to something gentle. A memory, an old friendship, a kindness. Good to visit, as long as you come back.
cups-six.reversed: Living in the past. Or refusing to let a good thing be over.
cups-six.phraseUpright: a gentle return to something older
cups-six.phraseReversed: living in a past that was not like that

cups-seven.name: Seven of Cups
cups-seven.upright: Many options, all of them appealing, none of them real yet. Dreaming is fine. Choosing is what makes one of them happen.
cups-seven.reversed: Seeing clearly which one you want. Or choosing the daydream over the decision again.
cups-seven.phraseUpright: many futures, all of them still imaginary
cups-seven.phraseReversed: the daydream chosen over the decision

cups-eight.name: Eight of Cups
cups-eight.keywords: Departure, seeking, leaving what is not enough
cups-eight.upright: Nothing here is wrong, and it is not enough. Leaving something good because it is not right is the hardest kind of leaving.
cups-eight.reversed: Staying out of guilt. Or leaving without ever saying why.
cups-eight.phraseUpright: leaving something good because it is not enough

cups-nine.name: Nine of Cups
cups-nine.upright: You got what you wanted and it is good. Let yourself enjoy it before you start looking for the next thing.
cups-nine.reversed: Getting it and feeling empty. Or moving the goal every time you reach it.
cups-nine.phraseUpright: getting the thing you actually wanted

cups-ten.name: Ten of Cups
cups-ten.upright: Not a good day but a good life. People who fit, and contentment you built rather than found. Take a moment to notice it.
cups-ten.reversed: Strain under a happy surface. Or measuring your life against somebody else's picture of one.
cups-ten.phraseUpright: contentment that was built rather than found

cups-page.name: Page of Cups
cups-page.upright: Something gentle and unexpected arrives. A message, an offer, an idea. Take it seriously even though it seems small.
cups-page.reversed: A feeling you cannot get out. Or imagination running well ahead of reality.
cups-page.phraseReversed: a feeling that will not come out

cups-knight.name: Knight of Cups
cups-knight.upright: Following the heart, sincerely and a little impractically. Warm and romantic, with the details to be worked out later.
cups-knight.reversed: Feeling treated as a plan. A promise that will not survive real life.
cups-knight.phraseUpright: the heart moving faster than the plan
cups-knight.phraseReversed: a promise that will not survive a calendar

cups-queen.name: Queen of Cups
cups-queen.upright: Someone who understands feelings clearly, her own and other people's. Steady, kind, and hard to shock.
cups-queen.reversed: Overwhelmed by other people's feelings. Or caring for everyone except herself.
cups-queen.phraseReversed: being swamped by everybody else's feelings

cups-king.name: King of Cups
cups-king.upright: Feeling deeply and staying steady. Not hiding emotion, but choosing what to do with it.
cups-king.reversed: Shut down and calling it calm. Or calm on the outside and churning underneath.
cups-king.phraseReversed: being shut down and calling it calm

swords-ace.name: Ace of Swords
swords-ace.upright: A clear thought cuts through the confusion. You can name it now. Say it plainly, even though it is uncomfortable.
swords-ace.reversed: Thinking that goes round and round. Or the truth used to hurt rather than to help.
swords-ace.phraseUpright: one clear thought cutting through the fog
swords-ace.phraseReversed: thinking that goes round and round

swords-two.name: Two of Swords
swords-two.upright: Two options and no decision. You say you need more information. Most of it is already here.
swords-two.reversed: The decision finally made. Or avoiding it until it decides itself.
swords-two.phraseUpright: a decision avoided rather than weighed
swords-two.phraseReversed: the blindfold coming off at last

swords-three.name: Three of Swords
swords-three.upright: It hurt, and it was true. Something was said or found out and it went deep. Clean pain heals; a comfortable lie does not.
swords-three.reversed: The hurt beginning to heal. Or going over it so often that it never can.
swords-three.phraseUpright: a truth that hurt going in
swords-three.phraseReversed: a hurt gone over so often it cannot close

swords-four.name: Four of Swords
swords-four.upright: Stop and rest. This is repair, not defeat. You cannot handle what is next from where you are now.
swords-four.reversed: Rest refused, or long overdue. Or resting so long that it has become avoiding.
swords-four.phraseUpright: rest taken as repair rather than defeat
swords-four.phraseReversed: rest refused, or hiding called rest

swords-five.name: Five of Swords
swords-five.keywords: Hollow victory, cost, conflict won badly
swords-five.upright: You won and it cost more than it was worth. Ask what you were really fighting for, and whether being right was worth this.
swords-five.reversed: Making peace, or refusing to. Letting it go, or holding on long after it ended.
swords-five.phraseUpright: a win that cost more than it was worth
swords-five.phraseReversed: a grudge held long after it ended

swords-six.name: Six of Swords
swords-six.upright: Moving from something hard toward something calmer. Not triumphant, just the relief of getting away from what hurt.
swords-six.reversed: Stuck between the two. Or taking the trouble along with you.
swords-six.phraseUpright: the move from rough water to calmer
swords-six.phraseReversed: the trouble carried along into the calm

swords-seven.name: Seven of Swords
swords-seven.upright: Getting around the problem rather than through it. Sometimes that is clever and sometimes it is not honest. You know which this is.
swords-seven.reversed: Found out, or owning up. Sometimes it is a story you are telling yourself.
swords-seven.phraseUpright: going around the problem instead of through it
swords-seven.phraseReversed: the workaround found out, or owned up to

swords-eight.name: Eight of Swords
swords-eight.upright: You feel trapped, and most of what holds you is what you believe about your options. Look again. There is more room than it seems.
swords-eight.reversed: Working free. Or believing the trap more the longer you stay in it.
swords-eight.phraseUpright: a trap made mostly of what you believe

swords-nine.name: Nine of Swords
swords-nine.upright: Worry at its loudest, usually at night, usually about what has not happened. Very little of it survives the morning.
swords-nine.reversed: The worst of it passing. Or saying the fear out loud to someone at last.
swords-nine.phraseUpright: worry at its loudest, in the dark
swords-nine.phraseReversed: a fear finally said out loud

swords-ten.name: Ten of Swords
swords-ten.keywords: An ending, rock bottom, the worst of it done
swords-ten.upright: It is over, and it ended badly. The only comfort is direction: this is the bottom, and the light is already coming.
swords-ten.reversed: Getting back up. Or dragging out an ending that nobody will name.
swords-ten.phraseUpright: an ending that went as badly as it could
swords-ten.phraseReversed: getting back up, or refusing to name the end

swords-page.name: Page of Swords
swords-page.upright: Curious, watchful, asking the question nobody else will. Not wise yet, but paying real attention.
swords-page.reversed: Watching turned into suspicion. Or mistaking nerves for insight.
swords-page.phraseUpright: the question nobody else will ask
swords-page.phraseReversed: watching that has curdled into suspicion

swords-knight.name: Knight of Swords
swords-knight.upright: Fast, direct, and certain. Excellent in a crisis and hard work the rest of the time, because acting comes before thinking.
swords-knight.reversed: Speed with no aim. Bluntness that leaves damage behind it.
swords-knight.phraseUpright: acting first and thinking on the way
swords-knight.phraseReversed: speed with nothing to aim at

swords-queen.name: Queen of Swords
swords-queen.upright: She tells you the truth because she respects you. Clear rather than cold, and just as honest about herself.
swords-queen.reversed: Honesty used to keep people at a distance. Clarity with no warmth in it.
swords-queen.phraseUpright: the truth told plainly, out of respect
swords-queen.phraseReversed: clarity with no warmth left in it

swords-king.name: King of Swords
swords-king.upright: Sound judgment you can rely on. Fair, precise, and willing to say the difficult thing at the right moment.
swords-king.reversed: Rules used against people. Being right treated as more important than being kind.
swords-king.phraseUpright: judgment that can be relied on

pentacles-ace.name: Ace of Pentacles
pentacles-ace.upright: A real opportunity, the practical kind. Work, money, a place, a beginning. It is worth taking seriously and acting on.
pentacles-ace.reversed: An opportunity left alone. Or a plan with nothing solid underneath it.
pentacles-ace.phraseUpright: a practical opportunity with real ground under it
pentacles-ace.phraseReversed: an opportunity left where it lay

pentacles-two.name: Two of Pentacles
pentacles-two.upright: Balancing two demands, and managing it for now. The skill is real and so is the strain. Ask how long this can go on.
pentacles-two.reversed: Dropping one of them. Or quietly neglecting something to keep the rest going.
pentacles-two.phraseReversed: one of the two quietly dropped

pentacles-three.name: Three of Pentacles
pentacles-three.upright: Good work with people who are good at their part. Being valued for what you can do, and doing it together.
pentacles-three.reversed: Working alone when you should not be. Or effort that nobody recognizes.
pentacles-three.phraseUpright: good work done with people who are good at it
pentacles-three.phraseReversed: working alone when you should not be

pentacles-four.name: Four of Pentacles
pentacles-four.upright: Holding on to what you have. Sensible, and worth watching: what keeps you safe can also keep you stuck.
pentacles-four.reversed: Loosening your grip. Or letting the fear of losing it decide everything.
pentacles-four.phraseUpright: holding tightly to what you have
pentacles-four.phraseReversed: the grip loosening, or fear running the show

pentacles-five.name: Five of Pentacles
pentacles-five.upright: A hard stretch. Money, health, or feeling shut out. Help is closer than it feels, and asking is the hardest part.
pentacles-five.reversed: Things turning. Or getting through it alone when you did not have to.
pentacles-five.phraseUpright: a hard stretch with help closer than it feels
pentacles-five.phraseReversed: getting through it alone when you did not have to

pentacles-six.name: Six of Pentacles
pentacles-six.upright: Giving and receiving. Notice which side you are on right now, and whether the exchange is really fair.
pentacles-six.reversed: Help with conditions attached. Or being unable to accept any.
pentacles-six.phraseUpright: something passing between having and needing

pentacles-seven.name: Seven of Pentacles
pentacles-seven.upright: You have done the work and now you wait for it to grow. Ask honestly whether it is worth continuing at this pace.
pentacles-seven.reversed: Impatience, or effort in the wrong place. Digging it up to check the roots.
pentacles-seven.phraseUpright: the honest pause halfway through the growing
pentacles-seven.phraseReversed: digging it up to check the roots

pentacles-eight.name: Eight of Pentacles
pentacles-eight.upright: Practice. The same thing again, a little better each time. It is not glamorous and it is how anyone gets good.
pentacles-eight.reversed: Going through the motions. Or perfecting something that no longer matters.
pentacles-eight.phraseUpright: the same thing again, a little better

pentacles-nine.name: Nine of Pentacles
pentacles-nine.upright: Comfort you built yourself, enjoyed on your own terms. Not luck, just a long run of good decisions.
pentacles-nine.reversed: Comfort that keeps people out. Or security that rests on somebody else.
pentacles-nine.phraseUpright: comfort you built and can enjoy on your own terms

pentacles-ten.name: Ten of Pentacles
pentacles-ten.upright: Something built to last beyond you. Family, a stable base, roots. What stays when the effort stops.
pentacles-ten.reversed: A legacy that feels like a burden. Or trading the long term for the short one.
pentacles-ten.phraseReversed: a legacy that arrives as a burden

pentacles-page.name: Page of Pentacles
pentacles-page.upright: Learning something properly, without rushing. Not flashy, and the most likely to still be at it later.
pentacles-page.reversed: Studying and never starting. Or too impatient for the dull part.
pentacles-page.phraseReversed: study that never turns into starting

pentacles-knight.name: Knight of Pentacles
pentacles-knight.upright: Slow, thorough, reliable. Not exciting, and it arrives. Slow is a strategy, not a fault.
pentacles-knight.reversed: Stuck in the routine. Or so cautious that nothing moves at all.
pentacles-knight.phraseUpright: slow, thorough, and certain to arrive
pentacles-knight.phraseReversed: being so cautious that nothing moves

pentacles-queen.name: Queen of Pentacles
pentacles-queen.upright: Care shown in practical ways. Making sure people are fed, warm and looked after, without needing thanks for it.
pentacles-queen.reversed: Looking after everyone but yourself. Or work and home pulling each other apart.
pentacles-queen.phraseUpright: care shown in fed, warm, practical ways

pentacles-king.name: King of Pentacles
pentacles-king.upright: He built it and he knows how to keep it. Steady success, used for other people as well as himself.
pentacles-king.reversed: Owned by what he owns. Or control exercised through money.
pentacles-king.phraseUpright: steady success spent on other people too
pentacles-king.phraseReversed: being owned by the thing you own

wands.name: Wands
wands.text: Fire. Wands are what you want badly enough to start. Projects, passions, the nerve to begin and the energy to keep going. When they turn up in numbers, the question is about drive: what you are pouring yourself into, and whether it is the thing you meant to.
wands.gloss: Fire. What you want badly enough to start: drive, work, the nerve to begin.

cups.name: Cups
cups.text: Water. Cups are the inner weather and the people in it: love, friendship, grief, the whole business of feeling and of being connected to others. A spread full of Cups is asking about the heart of the matter rather than the mechanics of it.
cups.gloss: Water. What you feel and who you feel it about: love, friendship, grief.

swords.name: Swords
swords.text: Air. Swords are the mind at work: reasoning, arguing, deciding, and the damage all three can do. The suit has a reputation for being harsh, and it earns it, but a sword cuts confusion as readily as anything else.
swords.gloss: Air. The mind at work: truth, decisions, conflict, and the damage thinking can do.

pentacles.name: Pentacles
pentacles.keywords: Work, money, the body, home, what lasts
pentacles.text: Earth. Pentacles are the solid world: a job, a house, a budget, your health, the slow business of building something that stays built. The least glamorous suit, and the one most readings are actually about.
pentacles.gloss: Earth. The solid world: work, money, the body, the home, what lasts.

n1.name: One, the Ace
n1.text: The seed in fertile soil: all of the potential and none of the growth yet. Beginnings, opportunity, a fresh start, and the uncertainty that always comes with one.
n1.gloss: Aces are the seed. All of the potential and nothing grown yet.

n2.name: Two
n2.text: The fork in the road. Balance, partnership, a choice between two real options, or a stalemate when neither gets chosen.
n2.gloss: Twos are the fork in the road. Balance, or a choice between two real options.

n3.name: Three
n3.text: The first steps of a dance. The initial spark expands: growth, collaboration, something taking a shape you can see. Overextended, it scatters.
n3.gloss: Threes are the first growth. The spark takes a shape you can actually see.

n4.name: Four
n4.text: The foundation of a house. Stability, structure, order, ground to build on. Held too long, it settles into stagnation and rigidity.
n4.gloss: Fours are the foundation. Stable, structured, and easy to get stuck in.

n5.name: Five
n5.text: The storm that shakes the tree. Change forced from outside, conflict, loss, and the adaptation that comes out of it. Every suit's most uncomfortable card.
n5.gloss: Fives are the storm. Something forced from outside, and the adapting that follows.

n6.name: Six
n6.text: The calm after. Harmony restored, recovery, help given and received, progress flowing again, or a comfort you have gone to sleep in.
n6.gloss: Sixes are the calm after. Recovery, help given and received, movement again.

n7.name: Seven
n7.text: The mountain path, partway. Assessment, perseverance, strategy, looking back at how far you have come and forward at what is left.
n7.gloss: Sevens are the mountain path partway up. Assessment, patience, strategy.

n8.name: Eight
n8.text: The engine of a well-oiled machine. Mastery, movement, determination, skill turning into power. Left unwatched, it becomes overwork.
n8.gloss: Eights are the engine. Mastery and momentum, and the standing risk of overwork.

n9.name: Nine
n9.text: The fruit on the vine, almost ripe. Nearly there: the rewards of hard work, resilience, and the particular strain of the last stretch.
n9.gloss: Nines are the fruit almost ripe. Nearly there, and the strain of the last stretch.

n10.name: Ten
n10.text: The closing chapter. Completion, culmination, the end of the cycle, and in the same card the door it opens on the next one.
n10.gloss: Tens are the closing chapter. Completion, and the door it opens on the next one.

page.name: Page
page.text: The child: curious, open, at the very start of learning this element. Pages bring news and beginnings, and their inexperience is the point. They are still willing to be surprised.
page.gloss: Pages are the student. New to this element, curious, still willing to be surprised.

knight.name: Knight
knight.text: The teenager: all pursuit and momentum, charging at the thing with more nerve than judgment. Knights get things moving, and the caution in every one of them is against rushing.
knight.gloss: Knights are the pursuit. All momentum, and more nerve than judgment.

queen.name: Queen
queen.text: The one who understands it from the inside. Queens hold their element rather than chase it: mature, perceptive, and the ones you go to when you need to be genuinely understood.
queen.gloss: Queens hold the element from the inside. Mature, perceptive, and not chasing it.

king.name: King
king.text: The one who can hold it steady for other people. Mastery and responsibility: authority earned rather than claimed, and the risk in every King is that it hardens into control.
king.gloss: Kings hold it steady for other people. Mastery, responsibility, and the risk of control.

past-present-future.name: Past, Present, Future
past-present-future.blurb: The familiar three: where this came from, where it stands, and where it is heading if nothing changes.

situation-obstacle-advice.name: Situation, Obstacle, Advice
situation-obstacle-advice.blurb: The most practical three cards there are: what is really going on, what is in the way, and what would help.

mind-body-spirit.name: Mind, Body, Spirit
mind-body-spirit.blurb: Three views of how you are rather than what to do. Good for a check-in with yourself.

past.name: Past
past.blurb: What this grew out of, and what it is still made of.

present.name: Present
present.blurb: Where the situation actually stands right now.

future.name: Future
future.blurb: Where this is heading on its current course, which is not a fixed fate.

situation.name: Situation
situation.blurb: The heart of it, as it really is rather than as it is being described.

obstacle.name: Obstacle
obstacle.blurb: What stands in the way, including anything you are contributing to it.

advice.name: Advice
advice.blurb: What would actually help, taken up on purpose.

mind.name: Mind
mind.blurb: What you are thinking, and how it is shaping the rest.

body.name: Body
body.blurb: What your body and your daily life are saying about this.
body.frame: In your body and your days: {card}.

spirit.name: Spirit
spirit.blurb: What matters underneath, the part that is not about the practicalities.

what-it-is.title: What a tarot deck is
what-it-is.p1: A tarot deck is seventy-eight pictures of things that happen to people. Beginnings, losses, the moment you realize you have been avoiding a decision, the particular tiredness of carrying too much. Each card is one of those, drawn so you can look at it from outside.
what-it-is.p2: It is a tool for reflection, not a source of information. The cards do not know anything about you and they are not going to tell you what happens next. What they do is hand you a specific idea at a moment when your own thinking has gone in circles, and ask you what it has to do with your situation. The useful part is your answer, not the card.
what-it-is.p3: That is also why a reading is worth doing slowly. Anyone can look up what a card means; the whole skill is in noticing what it means right here, in this question, in this position, next to that other card.

anatomy.title: Anatomy of a deck
anatomy.p1: Seventy-eight cards, in two groups. Twenty-two Major Arcana carry the big turns, the ones you would name if you told the story of your life in ten sentences. Fifty-six Minor Arcana carry everything else: the week, the argument, the job, the friendship.
anatomy.p2: The Minors are dealt into four suits of fourteen. Each suit runs Ace through Ten and then adds four court cards, Page, Knight, Queen and King, which read as people, or as parts of yourself, rather than as events.
anatomy.p3: So every Minor card is a suit and a number: what part of life this touches, and how far along it is. Six of Cups is the sixth stage of the emotional suit, and once you know what sixes do and what Cups are about, you have most of the meaning before you ever look it up.

how-to-read.title: How to read
how-to-read.p1: Start with a question, and make it a real one. Not "what does the future hold," which has no answer and no use. Something like "what am I not seeing about this job" or "what would help me be a better friend to her right now." A question with a shape gives the cards something to be about.
how-to-read.p2: Then choose a spread. Every seat in a spread asks its own question, and that is where most of the meaning comes from: the same card in the "obstacle" seat and the "advice" seat says two completely different things. Read the seat first, then the card, then both together.
how-to-read.p3: Look at the reading as a whole before you go card by card. Are these mostly Major Arcana, which would say the situation is bigger than the week it is happening in? Mostly one suit? Mostly low numbers, which are beginnings, or high ones, which are endings? The pattern is often the clearest thing in the spread.
how-to-read.p4: Then let yourself disagree with it. A card that lands wrong is still useful, because working out exactly why it does not fit tends to tell you what does. The deck is a prompt, and you are the one doing the reading.

intention.title: Setting an intention
intention.p1: Before you shuffle, take a moment and decide what you are actually here for. What do you want to understand, and are you willing to hear something you had not planned on? A minute of that beforehand does more for a reading than any amount of technique afterward.
intention.p2: Narrow the question until it points somewhere. "What can I focus on to make this friendship better" beats "is this friendship going to work out." The first one you can act on, and the second only asks the cards to make a promise they cannot keep.
intention.p3: Then hold it while you shuffle, and let it go while you read. Coming to a spread determined to see one particular answer is the surest way to get it, and the least useful reading there is.

spreads.title: Choosing a spread
spreads.p1: Every spread here is three cards in a row. What changes is the question each seat asks, and that is the part worth learning: a card means one thing in the seat called obstacle and quite another in the seat called advice. Read the seat first, then the card, then the two together.
spreads.p2: Past, Present, Future is the familiar one, and it suits anything with a history behind it: how this got here, where it stands now, and where it goes if nothing changes. Situation, Obstacle, Advice is the most practical of the three, and the one to reach for when you are stuck rather than curious.
spreads.p3: Mind, Body, Spirit is the odd one out, because it does not ask what to do at all. It asks how you are, in three places at once. That makes it the right spread for a day when the honest answer to what to do is that you do not know yet.

reversals.title: Reversals
reversals.p1: A reversed card is one dealt upside-down. It is an optional practice, and plenty of readers never use them. It makes a reading harder and more precise at the same time.
reversals.p2: Reversed does not simply mean the opposite. More often it means the card's energy is blocked, delayed, turned inward, or overdone: the Star reversed is not despair so much as hope you cannot quite reach, and the Devil reversed is often the beginning of getting free rather than a deeper trap.
reversals.p3: If you are new to the deck, leave them off for a while. Learn what each card says the right way up first; the shadow readings make far more sense once you know what they are the shadow of.

majors.title: The Major Arcana
majors.p1: Twenty-two cards, numbered zero to twenty-one, telling one story: the Fool's Journey. The Fool steps off the edge knowing nothing, meets every figure and force there is, and arrives at the World, whole and ready to begin again.
majors.p2: Read in order they are a life. The Magician and the High Priestess are what you can do and what you already know; the Emperor and the Hierophant are the structures you inherit; the Tower is the collapse that has to happen; the Star is the quiet afterward.
majors.p3: In a reading, a Major Arcana card raises the stakes. It says this is not really about the week. It is about a turn you are in the middle of, whether or not you had noticed.

suits.title: The four suits
suits.p1: The Minor Arcana divides into four suits, one for each element, and between them they cover most of an ordinary life: what drives you, what you feel, what you think, and what you build.
suits.p2: The suits also talk to each other. Wands and Cups often pull against each other, passion against feeling, while Pentacles and Cups sit well together, which reads as emotional life on solid ground. A spread heavy in one suit is telling you where your attention actually is.

numbers.title: Numbers
numbers.p1: Every Minor card is a stage as well as a suit. The numbers run the same way in all four: Aces are seeds and Tens are endings, and everything between is a step along that road.
numbers.p2: So a spread full of low numbers is a beginning, whatever else it says, and one full of nines and tens is something finishing. Read the numbers before you read the cards and half the spread explains itself.

court.title: The court cards
court.p1: Four ranks in each suit, and they read as people rather than events: someone in your life, or a part of yourself, approaching that suit's territory in a particular way.
court.p2: They also make a sequence of growing up in that element: the Page is learning it, the Knight is charging at it, the Queen understands it from the inside, and the King can hold it steady for other people.

tarot.majorGloss: Twenty-two cards for the turns you would name if you told your life in ten sentences. When one lands, the reading is not about your week. It is about something you are in the middle of, whether or not you had noticed.
